FiveAxisToolpathGenerator.description: Implements basic toolpath structure but uses hardcoded tool axes (0,0,1) and mock machine coordinates (A=0, C=0). No genuine 5-axis drive-surface projection logic.

ForwardKinematicsSolver.description: Implements basic analytical transformations for 3, 4, and 5-axis (Table-Table/Head-Head/Head-Table) but assumes fixed rotation orders and lacks comprehensive calibration error models.

InverseKinematicsSolver.description: Analytical solver for specific 4/5-axis architectures. Detects singularities and limit violations, but doesn't handle complex multi-solution branch selection robustly.

CollisionDetector.description: Implements adaptive sampling for continuous motion and broad/narrow phase checks. However, NarrowPhase is limited to analytical Capsule/AABB primitives.

NarrowPhaseCollisionEngine.description: Lacks GJK/EPA or BRep-level collision. Limited to simple primitive distance queries.

SweptVolumeEngine.description: Calculates AABB envelopes using sampled SLERP poses, but no explicit swept-hull mesh or BRep generation.

MaterialRemovalEngine.description: Basic voxel grid subtraction. Only supports vertical Z-aligned cylinders. Tool orientation in 5-axis is ignored during removal.

INSPECTION_FEEDBACK_LOOP.description: No 'ClosedLoopMetrologyInversionEngine' or 'ICP' alignment logic found in the manufacturing or metrology modules. This is the primary gap for CAP-SUP-005.

duplicated_logic_findings: Overlapping 'HardAcceptanceGate' logic (103, 104, 105, 106, 109, 110) suggests fragmented verification per module rather than a unified truth contract.
forensic_verdict: CAP-SUP-005 infrastructure is 70% partially implemented (MOCK/SIMULATED) but the core 'Closed-Loop Feedback' logic is 100% MISSING.
